## ProofsModule.acceptProposal() method

Accept a presentation proposal as verifier (by sending a presentation request message) to the connection associated with the proof record.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
acceptProposal(proofRecordId: string, config?: {
        request?: {
            name?: string;
            version?: string;
            nonce?: string;
        };
        comment?: string;
    }): Promise<ProofRecord>;
```

| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| proofRecordId | string                                                                                | The id of the proof record for which to accept the proposal       |
| config        | { request?: { name?: string; version?: string; nonce?: string; }; comment?: string; } | <i>(Optional)</i> Additional configuration to use for the request |
